mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate signals tightening monetary policy, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC >0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly demand surge (GDPC1 growth exceeding +3.0%) predicts increased corporate earnings and investor confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) despite meeting growth threshold, or GDPC1 growth reverses before returns materialize.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in federal funds rates and decline in unemployment rates (UNRATE) creates conflicting signals, but their combined effect during a tightening cycle amplifies discount rate pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening cycle with improving labor market
failure_condition: 20d returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) despite the interaction, or the proxies move in opposite directions.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market strengthening regime (UNRATE decline persists), improving employment conditions boost corporate profits and investor sentiment, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) despite UNRATE decline, or regime conditions reverse before returns materialize.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected surge in industrial production (INDPRO exceeding 105.0) signals robust supply-side capacity, boosting corporate investment and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns within 20 days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) despite INDPRO crossing threshold, or supply growth reverses.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly growth in both personal consumption (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) amplifies demand pressures, driving up corporate earnings and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST grow by >2.0% MoM
failure_condition: 5d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) despite dual demand growth, or one proxy reverses before the other.

mechanism_narrative: During a prolonged late-cycle monetary easing phase (FEDFUNDS decline continues), reduced discount rates on future cash flows enhance equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) despite sustained FEDFUNDS decline, or easing reverses.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment rates (UNRATE below 4.0%) reflects labor market strength, boosting corporate profits and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) despite UNRATE crossing threshold, or recovery stalls.
